summary: The inherited Weekly/H4 20%-of-pivot-spacing zone was too broad for the pivot-specific wick interaction. In the preregistered seven-geometry 2015-2021 family, only SP10 (core 0-10% of adjacent weekly-pivot spacing with equal-width 40-50% control) passed both structural and wick gates after Holm correction. Its structural terminal effect was +1.002 pp and wick interaction +1.616 pp, versus +0.669 pp and +0.774 pp for the exactly reproduced SP20 reference. ATR-capped hybrid zones did not pass the wick gate.
robustness: SP10 development wick interaction +1.688 pp and validation +1.436 pp
SP10 frozen core wick-bin gradient is non-decreasing
SP20_REF reproduces the parent structural and wick point estimates exactly to floating-point precision
SP15, SP20, SP25 and all three ATR-capped hybrids fail the joint wick gate
two preliminary weekly runs were invalidated before acceptance and documented because they did not meet deterministic SP20 reference reproduction
limitations: SP10 was selected within a preregistered seven-geometry internal 2015-2021 family; it is not yet an independently confirmed Weekly/H4 result.
The equal-width SP10 control is 40-50% of spacing, so the larger contrast reflects both a more local core and greater distance from the pivot in the matched control.
Post-decision decomposition showing stronger 0-10% wick exhaustion versus the adjacent 10-20% bin is descriptive only.
ATR-capped hybrids tested only coefficients 0.50, 0.75 and 1.00 under the preregistered min(20% spacing, k*ATR) construction.
Structural midpoint analysis only; no executable strategy or P&L.
authorized_next: Freeze SP10 unchanged for future independent Weekly/H4 confirmation.
Prefer genuinely fresh data after the current cache end for the cleanest confirmation because 2022-2025 has now been viewed for a separate Daily/H1 pivot hypothesis.
prohibited_next: Do not tune 5%, 7.5%, 12.5% or other weekly spacing widths on 2015-2021.
Do not add new ATR coefficients, switch min to max hybrid geometry, remove pairs, select named pivots, change wick thresholds or add sessions as a rescue on the same sample.
Do not use 2022-2025 Weekly/H4 outcomes without a new explicit authorization and preregistration.
